summary: Genmab A/S filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing an English translation of its restated Articles of Association dated November 10, 2026, signed by CFO Anthony Pagano. The exhibit recites the DKK 62,570,683 share capital in DKK 1 shares, board authorizations through March 12, 2029 to increase capital by up to DKK 6,600,000 with and without pre-emption rights, and employee warrant programs. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or closing date is stated. This is an ordinary corporate-governance charter update, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
